sections.Profile:
The Tiger pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in August 1975, is an electro-mechanical, single-player game designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison. With a production run of 1,100 units, Tiger was primarily distributed in Italy. It features a circus theme and includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, a spinning target, and an upper right return ball rollunder.
